newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500s futures switch course, drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500s futures switch course, drop.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures switched course, fell to lows. Trade mostly local, who sold and hit small sellstops below 803.00. Next support near 800.55, 795.50. Premium shrank below 2.95 pts needed for arb sell programs before NYSE curb set. Futures had firmed with T-bond futures, which rose after Fed's coupon pass, before backing off from peaks.
